notes: SalMar ASA is one of the world's largest producers of farmed Atlantic salmon, with operations in Northern Norway, Central Norway, Iceland (Icelandic Salmon) and offshore (SalMar Aker Ocean / Ocean Farm 1). Reports and lists in NOK on Oslo Børs. FY = calendar year. NTS ASA (Norway Royal Salmon + SalmoNor) acquired Q4 2022 — FY22 includes partial-year contribution and FY23 is the first full consolidated year. Segment cost split estimated from feed/salary disclosure.

periods.notes: FY20: Revenue NOK 12,846M, Operational EBIT NOK 2,040M. Pre-NTS perimeter.
FY21: Revenue NOK 13,796M, Operational EBIT NOK 2,481M. Recovering salmon price.
FY22: Revenue NOK 19,818M, Operational EBIT NOK 4,890M. NTS acquisition closed Q4 (debt step-up). Dividend cancelled following Norwegian resource-rent tax announcement Sept 2022.
FY23: Revenue NOK 23,919M, Operational EBIT NOK 5,389M. First full year incl. NTS. Resource-rent tax in effect.
FY24: Revenue NOK 25,770M, Operational EBIT NOK 5,186M. Record harvest volume ~244kt GWE.
